items.title: Announcing the Visual Intelligence Summit
items.summary: The Visual Intelligence Summit (October 22) is a gathering in San Francisco for the people building AI that sees and acts in the physical world.

items.title: On-Premise Computer Vision: Run Vision AI on Your Own Servers
items.summary: On-premise computer vision lets you run vision AI on your own servers, edge devices, or factory hardware. Learn how local inference works, which deployment fits, what hardware you need, how to set up Roboflow Inference, and how to manage models securely at scale.

items.title: How to Verify Torque Marks with Computer Vision
items.summary: Learn how to verify torque marks with computer vision using RF-DETR and a Vision-Language Model.

items.title: Self-Hosted Computer Vision: Run Your Own Vision Stack with Roboflow Inference
items.summary: Learn how to deploy self-hosted computer vision models for privacy, low latency, and offline use. See how Roboflow Inference simplifies local deployment

items.title: What Is An Inference Server?
items.summary: Run an inference server yourself for low latency, on-prem data, or offline use; use a hosted API otherwise. Start one locally with Docker.

items.title: mAP@0.5 vs. mAP@0.5:0.95: What’s the Difference?
items.summary: mAP@0.5 uses a single 0.50 IoU threshold; mAP@0.5:0.95 averages ten thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95. See how each is calculated and when to use it.

items.title: Moving from Manual Inspection to Machine Vision: A Regulatory Field Guide for Medical Device Quality Teams
items.summary: Automated visual inspection validation under QMSR: an inspection method change is a letter to file, not a 510(k). Here is the evidence package.

items.title: How to Build an AI Basketball Shot Evaluator
items.summary: Build a local basketball shot tracker using an RF-DETR detector and zero-shot keypoint tracking. Learn how to calibrate distance from the rim, detect shot release with pose data, handle net occlusions using physics, and render live mechanics overlays onto your video.

items.title: Build a Defect Detection System
items.summary: In this guide, we show how to build a defect detection and visual inspection system with computer vision using Roboflow.

items.title: Wood Defect Detection with Computer Vision
items.summary: In this guide, learn how to use a wood surface inspection system to identify defects on wood.

items.title: Top Models for AI Data Labeling
items.summary: Labeling is the slowest part of building a vision model. The fix is letting a foundation model take the first pass while a human reviews. We benchmarked every top vision model on object detection to find which ones you can trust with the job, and how to pick between them.

items.title: How to Build an AI Video Car Damage Inspector
items.summary: Upload one slow walkaround video of a rental car and get back a signed, timestamped report of every scratch and dent, with reflections filtered out by physics. Here's how to build it with RF-DETR, Roboflow Workflows, and Gemini.

items.title: How Cloud Connected AI Products Run On-Prem
items.summary: The Purdue Model explained: every level from PLC to DMZ, the companies that run on it, and how AI deploys into segmented OT networks.

items.title: Qwen3.8-Max for Vision: Benchmarks, Strengths, and Real-World Tests
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Max tops our VLM object detection benchmark and performs strongly on counting and reasoning. We test its strengths, limits, speed, cost, and deployment.

items.title: Bottle Cap Inspection with Computer Vision
items.summary: Learn how to use computer vision to verify the integrity of bottle caps on an assembly line.

items.title: How to Detect Small Objects in Drone Imagery
items.summary: Train RF-DETR to detect people and vehicles that appear small in aerial imagery, then build a Roboflow Workflow that counts detections and uses Gemini to inspect the scene.

items.title: Dwell Time and Zone Analytics with Vision AI
items.summary: Measure dwell time and zone analytics from any camera: train RF-DETR, track people with ByteTrack, and time each visitor inside a defined zone.

items.title: P&ID Symbol Detection for Engineering Drawing Digitization
items.summary: Detect common symbols in piping and instrumentation diagrams, then use OCR to extract text from instrument-related regions.

items.title: Zero-Shot vs. Fine-Tuned Models: When to Train Your Own
items.summary: Zero-shot vs fine-tuned models: prototype with SAM 3, auto-label your dataset, then train RF-DETR for the accuracy and speed production needs.

items.title: How Often Should You Retrain a Computer Vision Model?
items.summary: Learn how to recognize performance decline, data drift, new edge cases, and other signs that indicate a computer vision model needs retraining.

items.title: Human-Object Interaction Detection with RF-DETR
items.summary: Build human-object interaction detection for warehouses: RF-DETR finds workers and equipment, Gemini 2.5 Pro describes the interactions.

items.title: Computer Vision PLC Integration: Turn Detections into Machine Actions
items.summary: Computer vision PLC integration turns detections into real machine actions. Learn how cameras, RF-DETR, Roboflow Workflows, edge inference, and protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus TCP, and EtherNet/IP connect vision systems to PLCs for reject, stop, alert, and quality-control tasks.

items.title: Powder-Coat Defect Detection
items.summary: Detect craters, orange peel, bubbles, and scratches with RF-DETR, then use Gemini 2.5 Pro to summarize the visible defect and its apparent severity in the annotated image.

items.title: Building a Pool Monitor with Raspberry Pi and Roboflow
items.summary: How to use a Raspberry Pi, a phone camera, and a Roboflow classification model to know when a pool needs a refill.

items.title: Machine-Vision AI for Surface Defect Severity Assessment
items.summary: Build a computer vision pipeline for identifying surface defect severity and evaluating product quality.

items.title: Shop Floor Data Collection: How to Automate It with Computer Vision
items.summary: Shop floor data is usually typed into forms after the fact. Cameras already see every unit, defect, and stoppage. Learn how to turn those observations into timestamped production events with RF-DETR, Roboflow Workflows, and Vision Events, including a working cycle-time example.

items.title: What Is a Unified Namespace? Where Vision AI Fits in the UNS
items.summary: A unified namespace gives every plant system one data model. Roboflow Workflows publish camera detections as MQTT events any MES can read.

items.title: Retail Object Detection with RF-DETR
items.summary: Train a model to detect empty shelf spaces and automate restocking decisions.

items.title: Production Line Monitoring With Camera AI
items.summary: Build production line monitoring with camera AI: train RF-DETR to detect defects, count bottles, and trigger alerts with Roboflow Workflows.

items.title: How to Make Automatic Highlight Reels from Kids' Soccer Games
items.summary: Upload a soccer game, click your kid once, and get back a highlight reel with every play they were part of. Two RF-DETR models trained in the Roboflow UI handle detection and tracking, and a local Python pipeline reads jersey numbers, finds the goals, and cuts the clips.

items.title: Run RF-DETR in NVIDIA DeepStream on Jetson
items.summary: From pretrained weights to live multi-camera inference on a Jetson Orin NX: TensorRT engine build, the custom bbox parser DeepStream needs, and per-class colors with a pyds probe.

items.title: Hog Ring Detection with Computer Vision
items.summary: Detect visible hog rings with RF-DETR, compare their positions with predefined attachment zones, and use Gemini 2.5 Pro to generate an automotive seat inspection summary.

items.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash for Vision: Evaluation and Benchmarks
items.summary: Cheaper and faster than Gemini 3.5 Flash, and the best model we tested on video. Object detection is the one real step back.

items.title: Flanges Quality Inspection with Computer Vision
items.summary: Train RF-DETR to catch flange face defects, then sort results into pass, review, and fail.

items.title: Advanced Techniques for Optimizing AI Inference Costs
items.summary: In this guide, you will learn about advanced techniques that can help reduce AI inference costs across the complete computer vision pipeline.

items.title: Pipe and Tubes Quality Inspection with Roboflow
items.summary: Automate tube and pipe defect inspection. Train an RF-DETR model to detect holes, cracks, and ruptures, and build a pass, review, or fail Workflow in Roboflow.

items.title: Retail Object Detection with RF-DETR
items.summary: Detect visible beverage products with RF-DETR, compare their counts with fixed camera-frame thresholds, and use Gemini 2.5 Pro to generate a shelf inspection summary.

items.title: Teaching a Porch to Recognize Delivery Drivers and Accept Packages
items.summary: An end-to-end build of a self-unlocking porch lockbox: on-device detection on an old iPhone gates a cloud Roboflow Workflow, which validates courier-with-package events inside a drawn porch zone and triggers a solenoid lock through an ESP32. Includes delivery verification and a live dashboard.

items.title: Cosmetic Defect Detection with Computer Vision
items.summary: Learn how computer vision can automate cosmetic defect inspection by detecting paint scratches and identifying the affected car part. This guide shows how to train an RF-DETR model in Roboflow, build a part-level inspection Workflow, and return visual results and repair-ready outputs for QA review.

items.title: Multi-Model Auto Labeling for Segmentation with Roboflow Workflows
items.summary: Stack SAM 3, Gemini, and GPT into a single Workflow, require a 2-of-3 vote on every mask, and auto-label entire segmentation datasets without drawing a single polygon.

items.title: Roboflow Serverless Inference: A Thousand Models on a Shared GPU Fleet
items.summary: Most web services ingest kilobytes and emit the heavy bytes. Vision inference flips that, and breaks a few more production assumptions on the way. Here's the serverless architecture behind a thousand models on a shared GPU fleet.

items.title: GPT 5.6 Sol is the best "vision" model OpenAI ever released
items.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol is OpenAI’s strongest vision model yet. We tested Sol, Terra, and Luna across detection, counting, OCR, and extraction, then compared their results, speed, and cost with leading VLMs.

items.title: How to Scale a Computer Vision Pilot to Production in Manufacturing
items.summary: See how to scale a computer vision pilot to production: why 77% stall on integration, not the model, and how to get past it in manufacturing.

items.title: Best Computer Vision Models in 2026: A Task-by-Task Guide
items.summary: Explore the best computer vision models in 2026 for object detection, segmentation, classification, keypoints, OCR, vision-language tasks, depth estimation, and tracking. Compare leading models, benchmarks, licensing, deployment options, and when to fine-tune on custom data using Roboflow tools.

items.title: Open Vocabulary Segmentation with SAM 3 and Roboflow
items.summary: Learn how to build a zero-shot segmentation pipeline with SAM 3 and Roboflow Workflows.

items.title: Segment Anything with Text Prompts Using SAM 3
items.summary: Use Segment Anything with Text in Roboflow Workflows to segment workers, helmets, and safety vests without training a custom model.

items.title: Product Recognition AI
items.summary: Product Recognition AI helps businesses identify, count, and verify products from images or video. This blog explains key use cases and shows how to build a Roboflow Product-to-Bill Verification System that detects products, reads receipts, and checks billing accuracy.

items.title: Multi-Model Auto Labeling with Roboflow Workflows
items.summary: Roboflow has brought the full power of Workflows into Auto Label, letting you run custom pipelines serverlessly on your unannotated images. This post walks through building a sample multi-VLM workflow from scratch, then shows how to launch it on an image batch in a few clicks.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra & Luna Vision: Live in Roboflow Playground
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 family (Sol, Terra, and Luna) is now in the Roboflow Playground, so you can test all three tiers against your own visual data and compare them side by side with other frontier models.

items.title: Turn Predictions Into Better Models and Insights with Vision Events
items.summary: A vision system is only as useful as the data it produces. Vision Events now captures operator feedback right from the HMI, ships a built-in dashboard for every use case, and answers plain-language questions via the Roboflow MCP Server.
